description.narrative:
The overall objective of this project is to promote the sales and utilization of 51,000 eCook stoves in Bangladesh through an inclusive business model which will result in 100,000 t CO2-equivalent GHG emissions reduction per year and improves the livelihoods of 2,000 women and youth engaged in the Clean Energy Technology (CET) sector.
The Danida Green Business Partnerships (DGBP) programme funds and supports market-based partnership projects between commercial and non-commercial partners addressing climate and environmental challenges while contributing to inclusive growth and improved livelihoods. The programme builds on previous years’ experience with the private partnership program, DMDP.

The project is designed to address Bangladesh’s most pressing challenge in the nexus of climate, energy, and poverty by providing affordable access to clean cooking solutions for rural and peri-urban households. The aim is to develop a profitable business model that supports poor households with sustainable and environmentally safe cooking solutions.
